property_summary: For any address newOwner and any caller who is the current owner, calling setOwner(newOwner) either (a) succeeds and updates the public owner to newOwner, or (b) if the call reverts then the call did not succeed — i.e. the reference C always returns successfully and updates owner for owner-caller, whereas the mutant may revert (failing the call) leaving owner unchanged; we assert that when the caller is the current owner, the call must succeed (no revert) and thus owner equals the fuzzed newOwner.
change_summary: Inserted a revert before the assignment so setOwner will revert and owner remains unchanged.
